bead.title: providers/config: add ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort wire-format value
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-010 amendment (2026-05-11) §5'-7' requires a distinct wire-format value that serializes thinking control via the OpenAI 'effort' shape (reasoning_effort string), but no such constant exists. Providers that should round-trip to OpenAI-effort wire form currently have no enum to select against.

ROOT CAUSE: internal/config thinking-wire-format enum (the file declaring the existing ThinkingWireFormat* constants — locate via `grep -rn 'ThinkingWireFormat' internal/config`) defines the prior wire-format set but omits the OpenAIEffort variant called for in ADR-010 §5'.

PROPOSED FIX: (a) Add `ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort` to the wire-format enum alongside existing constants. (b) Implement its serializer/marshaler so the on-wire body is the OpenAI reasoning-effort shape (e.g. {"reasoning_effort":"low|medium|high"}). (c) Wire it into the wire-format String()/Parse() round-trip if those helpers exist. (d) Add a focused unit test `TestThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort_Serialize` asserting the produced JSON matches the OpenAI effort shape exactly.

NON-SCOPE: llamaserver chat_template_kwargs envelope (separate child); reasoning-token telemetry fallback (separate child); changes to provider selection logic beyond enum registration; any new provider integrations; provider-side effort→thinking translation policy beyond what ADR-010 §5'-7' specifies.

Governing artifacts: ADR-010 amendment 2026-05-11 §5'-7'; AR-2026-05-17-repo; source review fizeau-8e37e536.

VERIFICATION: `go test ./internal/config/... ./... -count=1` green; lefthook pre-commit and pre-push hooks pass.

AC:
1) `ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort` constant exists in the thinking-wire-format enum and is exported.
2) Test `TestThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort_Serialize` asserts the wire body uses the OpenAI `reasoning_effort` key.
3) Test `TestThinkingWireFormat_RoundTrip` (or extension thereof) covers OpenAIEffort in any existing String/Parse round-trip helper.
4) `go test ./... -count=1` passes.
5) lefthook hooks pass.
bead.acceptance:
1) ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort is defined in the wire-format enum package and exported.
2) TestThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort_Serialize asserts JSON body uses OpenAI reasoning_effort shape.
3) TestThinkingWireFormat_RoundTrip covers OpenAIEffort if a round-trip helper exists; otherwise N/A noted in PR.
4) go test ./... -count=1 green.
5) lefthook pre-commit and pre-push pass.
